"Sunflower"{{efn|Alternatively subtitled "(Spider Man: Into the Spider-Verse)"}} is a song by American musicians Post Malone and Swae Lee. It was released on October 18, 2018, as a single from the soundtrack to the 2018 animated film Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse, and was later included on Post Malone's third studio album Hollywood's Bleeding (2019). An official remix features fellow American singers Nicky Jam and Prince Royce.

"Sunflower" received universal acclaim from music critics. It became Malone's third and Lee's first song as a soloist to peak the US Billboard Hot 100 chart. The song ranked in the top ten of the chart for 33 weeks, at the time sharing the record for the most such weeks with "Girls Like You" by Maroon 5 featuring Cardi B and "Shape of You" by Ed Sheeran (Post Malone then broke this record with his 2019 single "Circles"). "Sunflower" also reached number one in Australia, Canada, Malaysia, and New Zealand, as well as the top ten in 12 additional countries. It has received double diamond (20-times platinum) certification by the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA) in the US, as well as diamond in Canada, Australia, and Mexico. By December 2023, it was set to become the first song to receive the certification in the United States—signifying 20 million units in sales; the certification was finalized in February 2024. The song was the fourth-best-selling R&B song of the 2010s decade in the US. On the Billboard Global 200 singles chart, the song peaked at number 20 upon the issue date of June 24, 2023.

"Sunflower" was nominated for Record of the Year and Best Pop Duo/Group Performance at the 62nd Annual Grammy Awards.

sections.heading: Background
sections.wikitext: Malone confirmed his involvement with ''[[Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse]]'' on October 2, 2018, on ''[[The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon]]'', in which he announced that he wrote "Sunflower", which he also performs, and played a snippet of the song.<ref name="Malone">{{cite magazine |url=https://www.billboard.com/music/rb-hip-hop/tonight-show-post-malone-previews-spider-man-track-talks-justin-bieber-watch-8477923/|title=Post Malone Previews 'Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse' Track, Talks Justin Bieber Tattoo Rivalry on 'Tonight Show': Watch|last=Kaufman|first=Gil|magazine=[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]|date=October 2, 2018|access-date=October 3, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181003120212/https://www.billboard.com/articles/columns/hip-hop/8477923/tonight-show-post-malone-previews-spider-man-track-talks-justin-bieber-watch|archive-date=October 3, 2018|url-status=live}}</ref> On October 15, [[Swae Lee]] revealed that he would also be on the song with Malone, and released another snippet of the song. Lee said that he was "very excited" for people to listen to the song.<ref name="SwaeMaloneBillboard">{{cite magazine |url=https://www.billboard.com/music/rb-hip-hop/swae-lee-previews-post-malone-spider-man-song-preview-8480240/|title=Swae Lee Previews Post Malone Collaboration For New 'Spider-Man' Soundtrack|last=Saporana|first=Michael|magazine=[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]|date=October 16, 2018 |access-date=October 16, 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181016224005/https://www.billboard.com/articles/columns/hip-hop/8480240/swae-lee-previews-post-malone-spider-man-song-preview|url-status=live|archive-date=October 16, 2018}}</ref> On October 19, 2018, "Sunflower" was released as a single.<ref name="ComplexSoundtrack"/> Spring Aspers, head of music and creative affairs at [[Sony Pictures]], said that "Post and Swae have delivered a song that's both heroic and emotional, which is exactly what a Spider-Man story needs. It's anthemic, but also heartfelt — the perfect soundtrack for [[Miles Morales|Miles]] to discover the [[Spider-Man]] inside himself".<ref name="variety" /> Swae Lee called "Sunflower" one of his favorite collaborations in 2018, when he stated it was "because it's a movie placement [in Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse]. The main character sings "Sunflower" and uses my vocals to calm him down in a certain situation—like my music was therapeutic for him".<ref>{{Cite magazine | url=https://www.billboard.com/music/rb-hip-hop/swae-lee-interview-swaecation-new-solo-project-2019-8491044/ |title = Swae Lee on His Prolific 2018, His Imminent 'All Bangers' Solo Project & Why He's 'The King of Melodies'|magazine = [[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]}}</ref> Malone and Lee previously collaborated on the song "Spoil My Night" for Malone's 2018 album ''[[Beerbongs & Bentleys]]''.
sections.text: Malone confirmed his involvement with Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse on October 2, 2018, on The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon, in which he announced that he wrote "Sunflower", which he also performs, and played a snippet of the song. On October 15, Swae Lee revealed that he would also be on the song with Malone, and released another snippet of the song. Lee said that he was "very excited" for people to listen to the song. On October 19, 2018, "Sunflower" was released as a single. Spring Aspers, head of music and creative affairs at Sony Pictures, said that "Post and Swae have delivered a song that's both heroic and emotional, which is exactly what a Spider-Man story needs. It's anthemic, but also heartfelt — the perfect soundtrack for Miles to discover the Spider-Man inside himself". Swae Lee called "Sunflower" one of his favorite collaborations in 2018, when he stated it was "because it's a movie placement [in Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse]. The main character sings "Sunflower" and uses my vocals to calm him down in a certain situation—like my music was therapeutic for him". Malone and Lee previously collaborated on the song "Spoil My Night" for Malone's 2018 album Beerbongs & Bentleys.

On October 19, 2018, a [[lyric video]] of the song was released. The video is composed of computer-animated footage from the film. The lyrics are presented in the comic book style of the film, edited into the context of various scenes, such as graffiti scrawled by Miles Morales.<ref name="ComplexSoundtrack"/> Since its release, as of 2025, the lyric video has received over 2.8 billion views on [[YouTube]].

On January 10, 2019, an official music video of the song was released, which is [[live action]]. The video contains an exclusive look at the [[Studio recording|recording session]] for the song showing the film logo behind Malone and Lee and a live performance.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3E78T8h5EhA|title=Post Malone & Swae Lee - Sunflower|date=January 9, 2019 |via=www.youtube.com|access-date=2019-02-10|archive-date=2019-05-25|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190525235609/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3E78T8h5EhA|url-status=live}}</ref> By 2023, the video had over 78 million views on YouTube.

sections.heading: Other versions
sections.wikitext:
*A remix of the song, featuring new lyrics performed by [[Nicky Jam]] and [[Prince Royce]], was released on February 22, 2019, as a bonus track in a deluxe version of the soundtrack of ''Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse''.<ref>{{Cite web| url=https://radiofacts.com/deluxe-edition-of-spider-man-into-the-spider-verse-official-soundtrack-album-available-now/| title=Deluxe Edition of 'Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse' Official Soundtrack Album Available Now| date=2019-02-22| access-date=2019-03-11| archive-date=2019-02-22| archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190222230325/https://radiofacts.com/deluxe-edition-of-spider-man-into-the-spider-verse-official-soundtrack-album-available-now/| url-status=dead}}</ref>
*American indie pop band [[Vampire Weekend]] covered "Sunflower" on [[BBC Radio 1]]'s [[Live Lounge]], in reference to their [[Sunflower (Vampire Weekend song)|single of the same name]] from ''[[Father of the Bride (album)|Father of the Bride]]'' (2019).<ref>{{cite web|url=https://pitchfork.com/news/listen-to-vampire-weekend-cover-post-malones-sunflower-on-live-lounge/|title=Watch Vampire Weekend Cover Post Malone and Swae Lee's "Sunflower"|last1=Blais-Billie|first1=Braudie|last2=Monroe|first2=Jazz|date=March 21, 2019|website=[[Pitchfork (website)|Pitchfork]]|access-date=March 22, 2019|archive-date=April 3, 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190403222305/https://pitchfork.com/news/listen-to-vampire-weekend-cover-post-malones-sunflower-on-live-lounge/|url-status=live}}</ref>
*For the sequel film, ''[[Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse]]'', covers of the song in various styles and languages were done, officially released by [[Madison Gate Records|Maddison Gate]], most famously, Indian duo DJs [[Tech Panda & Kenzani|Tech Panda & Kanzani]] and an Indian singer "Badal" remade the track to Indian musical traditions with Hindi vocals.<ref>{{Cite web |title=The Sunflower Covers (From and Inspired by the Motion Picture "Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse") - EP {{!}} Madison Gate Records |url=https://www.madisongaterecords.com/sunflower-covers-and-inspired-motion-picture-spider-man-across-spider-verse-ep |access-date=2024-03-09 |website=www.madisongaterecords.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Plus |first=Music |date=2023-06-07 |title=New Spider-Man movie features music from Nucleya, Tech Panda, Kenzani, and Badal |url=https://www.musicplus.in/new-spider-man-movie-features-music-from-nucleya-tech-panda-kenzani-and-badal/ |access-date=2024-03-09 |website=Musicplus |language=en-GB}}</ref>
sections.text:
*A remix of the song, featuring new lyrics performed by Nicky Jam and Prince Royce, was released on February 22, 2019, as a bonus track in a deluxe version of the soundtrack of Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse.
*American indie pop band Vampire Weekend covered "Sunflower" on BBC Radio 1's Live Lounge, in reference to their single of the same name from Father of the Bride (2019).
*For the sequel film, Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse, covers of the song in various styles and languages were done, officially released by Maddison Gate, most famously, Indian duo DJs Tech Panda & Kanzani and an Indian singer "Badal" remade the track to Indian musical traditions with Hindi vocals.
